blocks.text: This Return & Refund Policy applies to eligible BDSG Products purchased directly from BDSG Brands, LLC or through a BDSG-operated current or future brand storefront where this Policy is presented as applicable. Purchases from an independent BDSG Partner are generally handled by that independent seller, subject to applicable law, unless BDSG expressly assumes responsibility for the transaction or a product-quality matter.
1. Retail and Greatness Member Returns
Retail customers and Greatness Members follow the same ordinary product-return rules. Membership status does not extend the return window or create additional product-return privileges.

blocks.label: Return Window:
blocks.text: 15 calendar days from the purchase date.

blocks.label: Condition Requirement:
blocks.text: Product must be unopened and in its original, undamaged packaging.

blocks.label: Opened Product:
blocks.text: Opened cosmetic and personal care products are not eligible for ordinary preference-based returns or exchanges.

blocks.label: Proof of Purchase:
blocks.text: Order confirmation, receipt, or Member account record is required.

blocks.label: Return Shipping:
blocks.text: Customer is responsible for return shipping unless the product was defective or BDSG shipped the wrong item, or applicable law requires otherwise.

blocks.label: Refund Processing:
blocks.text: Approved Retail or Greatness Member product refunds are ordinarily processed within 7 to 10 business days after BDSG receives and inspects the authorized return.
These ordinary return limits do not eliminate a remedy that applicable law requires for a defective, unsafe, incorrectly shipped, or otherwise legally nonconforming product.
2. Damaged, Incorrect, Defective, Leaking, or Nonconforming Products

Product-quality and fulfillment problems are handled separately from ordinary preference-based returns. BDSG may request photographs, order information, lot or batch information, or return of the product to investigate.

Customers should contact BDSG promptly and may be asked to provide the order number, photographs, product name, lot or batch code, description of the issue, and other information reasonably necessary to investigate.
Depending on the circumstances, BDSG may replace the product, issue a refund, provide another appropriate remedy, request return of the product, or preserve the product for safety investigation.
3. Adverse Reactions and Safety Complaints

If you experience a significant adverse reaction, discontinue use and contact BDSG promptly. Seek appropriate medical care when necessary. BDSG may request information needed to evaluate product safety and meet applicable reporting obligations.
A safety complaint is not treated merely as a preference-based return and may be handled under separate safety and regulatory procedures.
4. Refund Timing

Approved Retail and Greatness Member product refunds are ordinarily processed within 7 to 10 business days after receipt and inspection of the authorized return. Approved Partner/Bulk refunds are ordinarily processed within 10 to 14 business days after receipt, inspection, and applicable restocking-fee deduction.
Your bank or payment provider may require additional time before the credit appears. Unless required by law or otherwise stated, refunds are returned to the original payment method.
5. Shipping Charges

Original shipping charges and return shipping charges are generally non-refundable for preference-based returns unless BDSG states otherwise. BDSG will address reasonable shipping costs associated with verified BDSG fulfillment errors or verified defective products as appropriate.
6. Greatness Membership Fees
Initial Registration

The $55 Greatness registration fee is refundable only if BDSG receives a written cancellation request within 24 hours after the timestamp of enrollment. If timely cancelled and refunded, the membership and associated benefits terminate immediately.
After 24 Hours

The initial registration fee is non-refundable and is not prorated, except where applicable law requires otherwise. A cancellation submitted after the initial refund window may stop future renewal but does not create a refund for the current paid term.
Annual Renewal

A cancellation request must be received at least 24 hours before the scheduled renewal charge and no later than 8:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (6:00 PM Mountain Time) on the cancellation-deadline date identified in BDSG's renewal notice.
How to Cancel
Use the Member account portal or the Greatness Membership cancellation method identified on bdsgbrands.com. BDSG may also provide an email, web form, or other written electronic method.
Missed Renewal Deadline

If the cancellation deadline is missed, the renewal may process automatically and the annual renewal fee is non-refundable. No partial-year refunds or prorated credits are provided, except where applicable law requires otherwise.

Utah Notice: For memberships subject to Utah Code Title 13, Chapter 70, BDSG will provide a clear renewal notice at least 30 and not more than 60 days before renewal stating the renewal date, total renewal cost, cancellation options, and applicable cancellation deadline.
7. Partner/Bulk Returns
Partner/Bulk purchases are subject to strict commercial return terms:

blocks.label: Return Window:
blocks.text: Return request must be submitted within 10 calendar days from the purchase date.

blocks.label: Authorization Required:
blocks.text: Written authorization from BDSG is required before any Partner/Bulk product is shipped back. Unauthorized returns may be refused.

blocks.label: Condition Requirement:
blocks.text: Product must be unopened, untouched, in original resalable condition, and free from damage to outer packaging, labeling, or seals.

blocks.label: Restocking Fee:
blocks.text: A 15% restocking fee applies to every approved Partner/Bulk return and is deducted from the refund, except where applicable law requires otherwise.

blocks.label: Defect or Damage Claims:
blocks.text: Report in writing within 5 calendar days after delivery and include photographs or other reasonable evidence.

blocks.label: Non-Returnable Items:
blocks.text: Opened, relabeled, repackaged, altered, expired/past-best-by, or non-original-packaging product is not eligible for return, except where applicable law requires a remedy.

blocks.label: No Market-Based Returns:
blocks.text: No returns for slow sales, excess inventory, seasonal factors, changed demand, or market conditions.

blocks.label: Return Shipping:
blocks.text: Partner pays return shipping unless BDSG expressly agrees otherwise or applicable law requires otherwise.

blocks.label: Refund Processing:
blocks.text: Approved refunds are ordinarily processed within 10 to 14 business days after BDSG receives and inspects the authorized return and applies the 15% restocking fee.
If this Policy conflicts with the BDSG Greatness Program & Partner Agreement concerning a Partner/Bulk transaction, the Greatness Program & Partner Agreement controls.
8. Suspected Fraud or Abuse

BDSG may deny or investigate return requests reasonably associated with fraud, product substitution, altered products, counterfeit products, abusive repeat returns, false claims, transaction manipulation, or attempts to return products not originally sold through the asserted BDSG Brand or authorized channel. Nothing in this section limits a non-waivable consumer right.
9. Purchases From Independent Partners or Other Sellers

If you purchased from an independent BDSG Partner, that Partner is generally the independent retail seller responsible for the retail transaction and its applicable return obligations. BDSG remains responsible for obligations that applicable law independently places on BDSG regarding product safety, manufacturing, labeling, or other non-transferable matters.
10. Contact

For product returns, refund requests, or product problems, use the BDSG Contact or Returns process at bdsgbrands.com and include available order information. Greatness membership cancellations are governed by Section 6.

BDSG Brands, LLC ("BDSG," "we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, retain, and protect personal information when you visit bdsgbrands.com, purchase directly from BDSG, create an account, enroll in Greatness, participate in referrals, qualify for Partner/Bulk transactions, communicate with us, or otherwise interact with BDSG.

Information You Provide
Name, email address, telephone number, billing and shipping address
Account credentials and account preferences
Order, return, refund, and purchase history
Greatness membership information and renewal status
Referral activity and reward information
Partner status, resale documentation, tax or business information where applicable
Customer service, complaint, product-safety, review, survey, or other communications
Marketing preferences and promotion entries
Payment Information

Payments are generally processed through third-party payment processors. BDSG ordinarily does not receive or store a complete payment-card number. We may receive limited transaction information such as payment status, payment type, billing information, tokenized identifiers, or portions of a card identifier when needed for payment, refunds, disputes, or fraud prevention.
Information Collected Automatically
IP address and approximate location derived from IP
Browser, operating system, device type, and device identifiers
Pages, products, links, and features viewed or used
Shopping cart, checkout, and conversion activity
Referring pages, campaign information, and advertising attribution
Date, time, session, security, and diagnostic information
We may collect this information using cookies, pixels, tags, local storage, software development kits, and similar technologies. See the Cookie Policy for more information.
2. How We Use Personal Information
Process, fulfill, ship, and support orders
Process payments, refunds, fraud reviews, chargebacks, and transaction disputes
Create and manage accounts
Administer Greatness membership and automatic renewal
Apply Member and Partner/Bulk pricing
Administer referral incentives and detect referral abuse
Verify Partner/Bulk eligibility and administer resale compliance where applicable
Provide customer service and product-safety support
Send transactional and service communications
Send marketing communications where permitted
Personalize shopping experiences and product recommendations
Measure website performance, advertising, and customer engagement
Detect, investigate, and prevent fraud, security incidents, counterfeiting, or abuse
Maintain product traceability, complaint, legal, tax, accounting, and compliance records
Establish, exercise, or defend legal claims
Comply with applicable legal and regulatory obligations
We may also use information in aggregated or deidentified form where it is not reasonably capable of identifying an individual.
3. How We Disclose Personal Information
Service Providers

We may disclose information to vendors that provide ecommerce hosting, payments, fraud prevention, shipping, fulfillment, warehousing, customer service, email or SMS communications, analytics, advertising, cybersecurity, accounting, legal, or information-technology services.
Advertising and Analytics Partners

We may use advertising and analytics technologies to measure campaigns, understand website usage, build audiences, attribute purchases, or deliver advertising. Depending on applicable state law, certain disclosures through advertising technologies may be considered a "sale," "sharing," or targeted advertising even when BDSG does not receive money for the information. Where required, BDSG will provide applicable opt-out choices.
Partners and Product-Safety Matters

Where reasonably necessary to investigate a product complaint, safety issue, recall, counterfeit concern, or transaction dispute, BDSG may exchange relevant information with an independent Partner, manufacturer, laboratory, insurer, professional adviser, carrier, regulator, or other appropriate party, subject to applicable law.
Legal and Business Transactions

We may disclose information to comply with law or legal process; respond to lawful governmental requests; investigate fraud or illegal activity; protect BDSG, customers, or others; enforce agreements; or in connection with a merger, acquisition, financing, restructuring, asset sale, or similar business transaction.
4. BDSG Does Not Sell Personal Information for Money

BDSG does not sell customer personal information in exchange for monetary payment. Certain advertising or analytics disclosures may nevertheless fall within broader state-law definitions of sale, sharing, or targeted advertising. Where such laws apply, BDSG will provide applicable privacy choices.
5. Cookies and Similar Technologies

BDSG uses cookies and similar technologies for essential website operation, security, cart and account functions, analytics, personalization, marketing measurement, and advertising. See the BDSG Cookie Policy for categories and available controls.
6. Email and Text Marketing

Promotional email recipients may unsubscribe using the link in the message. Unsubscribing from marketing does not prevent transactional communications concerning orders, memberships, payments, security, recalls, safety, or other service matters.

If BDSG offers SMS marketing, enrollment will be voluntary and subject to the consent terms presented at enrollment. Consent to marketing text messages is not required as a condition of purchasing BDSG products. Opt-out instructions will be provided with messages as required.
7. Greatness, Referral, and Partner Information

When you participate in Greatness, referral incentives, or Partner/Bulk purchasing, BDSG may collect and maintain information reasonably necessary to verify membership status, apply pricing, track qualifying referrals, calculate and reverse rewards, prevent self-referral or fraud, preserve evidence of agreement acceptance, administer resale restrictions, maintain tax records, and investigate disputes.
8. Product Complaints and Adverse Events

If you report a product complaint or adverse event, BDSG may collect information about the product, lot code, purchase, symptoms or reaction, photographs, communications, and other information reasonably necessary to investigate, fulfill legal reporting duties, protect consumers, or defend legal claims. Please do not submit unrelated medical records or highly sensitive information unless specifically requested and necessary.
9. Data Retention

BDSG retains personal information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy, including order fulfillment, membership administration, fraud and chargeback prevention, product traceability, tax and accounting, warranty and customer service, legal claims, safety investigations, and regulatory requirements.

Retention periods vary by category. BDSG may retain agreement-acceptance records, transaction records, product-safety and adverse-event records, and other legal/compliance records for longer periods where reasonably necessary or legally required.
10. Security

BDSG uses reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal information. No online system or storage method can be guaranteed completely secure. Customers are responsible for protecting account credentials and should notify BDSG promptly if they believe an account has been compromised.
11. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your state of residence, the size and activities of BDSG, and whether an applicable privacy law covers the processing, you may have rights to request access, correction, deletion, or portability of certain personal information; opt out of certain targeted advertising, sales, or sharing; withdraw consent where applicable; or appeal certain privacy-request decisions.

These rights may be subject to identity verification, legal exceptions, and statutory applicability thresholds. BDSG will not unlawfully discriminate against a consumer for exercising an applicable privacy right.
To submit a privacy request, use the BDSG Contact or Privacy Request process at bdsgbrands.com and identify the request as a privacy request.
12. Browser-Based Privacy Signals

Where required by applicable law and technically supported, BDSG will process legally recognized browser-based opt-out preference signals, such as Global Privacy Control, in accordance with applicable law and our technology configuration.
13. Children's Privacy

BDSG online services are not directed to children under 13, and BDSG does not knowingly collect personal information online from children under 13 without legally required parental authorization. If we learn that such information was collected contrary to applicable law, we will take appropriate steps to delete it.
14. International Visitors

BDSG is based in the United States. If you access BDSG services from another country, personal information may be transferred to, stored in, or processed in the United States or other countries where BDSG or its service providers operate. Different jurisdictions may provide different privacy protections.
15. Third-Party Websites and Services
BDSG may link to third-party websites or services. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies, and BDSG is not responsible for third-party services outside its control.
16. Changes to This Privacy Policy
BDSG may update this Privacy Policy periodically. The effective date will be updated when changes are published, and additional notice will be provided where required by applicable law.

This Cookie Policy explains how BDSG Brands, LLC ("BDSG," "we," "us," or "our") uses cookies and similar technologies on bdsgbrands.com. It should be read together with the BDSG Privacy Policy.
1. What Cookies Are

Cookies are small data files that websites place or access on a browser or device. Similar technologies include pixels, tags, web beacons, local storage, device identifiers, and software development kits. This Policy generally refers to these technologies collectively as "cookies."
2. Strictly Necessary Cookies
These technologies are used to provide essential website functions such as:
Shopping cart and checkout
Payment processing and transaction security
Account authentication
Fraud prevention and security
Network and session management
Remembering privacy selections
Because these technologies are necessary to provide requested functionality or protect the service, they generally cannot be disabled through BDSG cookie-preference controls.
3. Functional Cookies

Functional cookies may remember account preferences, prior selections, region or language choices, website settings, or other preferences that improve website functionality. Disabling them may reduce some features.
4. Analytics and Performance Cookies

Analytics technologies help BDSG understand visitor counts, pages viewed, traffic sources, site navigation, product interest, checkout activity, conversions, technical errors, and website performance. BDSG uses this information to improve the website, products, marketing, and customer experience.
5. Advertising and Targeting Cookies

Advertising technologies may help BDSG and advertising partners measure campaigns, attribute purchases, build advertising audiences, limit repetitive advertising, deliver more relevant advertising, or retarget visitors who previously interacted with BDSG.

Depending on applicable law, use of these technologies may be considered targeted advertising or the sale or sharing of personal information. Where required, BDSG will provide an appropriate opt-out mechanism.
6. First-Party and Third-Party Cookies

First-party cookies are set by or for BDSG and commonly support website operation and preferences. Third-party cookies or similar technologies may be provided by ecommerce, payment, fraud-prevention, analytics, advertising, social-media, customer-support, communications, or performance providers and may be subject to those providers' own privacy practices.
7. Session and Persistent Cookies

Session cookies generally expire when a browser session ends. Persistent cookies remain for a specified period or until deleted. Duration depends on the purpose of the technology and the provider responsible for it.
8. Cookie Preference Controls

Where BDSG provides a cookie preference center, visitors may be able to accept or reject categories of nonessential cookies and later change those selections. Strictly necessary cookies may continue to operate because they support essential functionality or security.

The cookie banner and preference center should be configured so that the technical behavior of cookies actually follows the user's legally required choices. Publishing this Policy alone does not disable nonessential tracking.
9. Browser Controls
Most browsers allow users to view, delete, block, or restrict cookies. Blocking cookies may affect account login, shopping carts, checkout, saved preferences, and other website functions.
10. Browser-Based Opt-Out Signals

Where required by applicable law and technically supported, BDSG will process legally recognized browser-based opt-out preference signals in accordance with applicable law and BDSG technology configuration.
11. Email Technologies

BDSG emails may contain technologies that allow us to determine whether a message was delivered, opened, or interacted with. We may use this information for communication effectiveness, security, and customer service, subject to applicable law and provider settings.
12. Changes to Cookie Providers

The specific cookies and providers used by BDSG may change as ecommerce, analytics, advertising, security, and customer-experience tools change. BDSG may update this Policy or its cookie preference center accordingly.
13. Changes to This Policy

BDSG may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in technology, website functionality, providers, business practices, or legal requirements. The effective date above identifies the current version.
14. Contact
Questions about cookies or tracking technologies may be submitted through the BDSG Contact or Privacy Request process at bdsgbrands.com.
